description: Golden fixtures for the v3 Tolerance Engine (CALCULATOR_SPEC 7). Reference instant C0 = 2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z (epoch ms 1787184000000). Equality is structural domain equality: kind, range, target, confidence, uncertainty code, drivers, limitations, policyVersion, calculatedAt. tolerance-v3 vs tolerance-v2: v3 classifies exposure over frequency + intensity (sessions per use day, concentrates, dabbing, read from 4 use days upward) + chronicity with at most one adjacent-tier movement, emits the v3 limitation codes, allows a clean in-range history observation to raise the planning target (never the range), and requires sessions/products/routes from 4 use days upward on range-requested routes. Each case whose v3 behaviour differs from v2 carries a `reason` comment.

cases.name: use_days_16_multiple_sessions_raise_21_to_28
cases.reason: v3 keeps the 16-25 intensity raise at 21-28 but records it as heuristic_frequency_intensity_v3; the retired v1 code is no longer emitted.

cases.name: use_days_20_concentrate_raise_21_to_28
cases.reason: v3 keeps the 16-25 concentrate raise at 21-28 but records it as heuristic_frequency_intensity_v3.

cases.name: use_days_25_dabbing_raise_21_to_28
cases.reason: v3 keeps the 16-25 dabbing-route raise at 21-28 but records it as heuristic_frequency_intensity_v3.

cases.name: use_days_15_intensity_raises_14_to_21
cases.reason: v3 reads intensity from 4 use days upward: 4 sessions/day plus concentrate and dabbing at 15 use days raises the tier-2 band one step to 14-21 (was 7-14 in v2). Missing duration anchors the upper target.

cases.name: use_days_20_all_intensity_drivers_raise_21_to_28
cases.reason: v3 keeps the 16-25 all-intensity raise at 21-28 but records it as heuristic_frequency_intensity_v3.

cases.name: use_days_10_missing_intensity_fields_validation_error
cases.reason: v3 makes sessions/products/routes REQUIRED from 4 use days upward on range-requested routes, so this 10-use-day profile without them now returns validation_error instead of a 7-14 range.

cases.name: use_days_27_recent_under_1_month_lower_target
cases.reason: v3 renames the within-range duration-target limitation to heuristic_duration_target_within_range_v3; range, target and drivers are unchanged.

cases.name: use_days_20_multi_session_recent_lower_target_within_raise
cases.reason: v3 records the same 21-28 result with the v3 limitation codes heuristic_frequency_intensity_v3 + heuristic_duration_target_within_range_v3 (v1/v2 codes retired).

cases.name: v3_use_days_10_multisession_concentrate_14_to_21
cases.reason: NEW acceptance (a): v3 reads intensity from 4 use days upward - 10 use days with 3 sessions/day of concentrate raises the regular non-daily 7-14 band one tier to 14-21; missing duration anchors the upper target 21.

cases.name: v3_use_days_20_long_established_21_to_28_chronicity
cases.reason: NEW acceptance (b): a long-established (5+ year) single-session frequent pattern moves one tier to 21-28 via heuristic_chronicity_range_v3 (no intensity present), anchored at the upper end 28.

cases.name: v3_use_days_10_recent_history_override_target_14
cases.reason: NEW acceptance (c): a clean in-range directional history observation raises the planning target inside the fixed range - the recent lower anchor 7 is raised to the observed 14 (heuristic_history_target_within_range_v3); the 7-14 range never moves.

cases.name: v3_use_days_10_recent_history_interior_target_10
cases.reason: v3 history override may target the user's own longest in-range observation even when it is not a range anchor: the recent anchor 7 is raised to the observed 10-day anchor, freezing the interior target.

cases.name: v3_use_days_25_vs_26_boundary_25_14_to_21
cases.reason: NEW acceptance (d): v3 leaves the frequency bands unchanged - 25 single-session flower use days stay in the frequent 14-21 band; see the paired 26-day case for the boundary crossing.

cases.name: v3_use_days_25_vs_26_boundary_26_21_to_28
cases.reason: NEW acceptance (d): one extra use day crosses 26 days into the near-daily/daily 21-28 band with the near_daily_or_daily_use driver.
